title: The native scalar tensor chain diagram commutes
statement: For the actual chain diagram G of finite R, p:X→Y and P,Q, its three left chain maps compose to its specified right chain map: G.l1 ≫ G.l2 ≫ G.l3 = G.right.

proof.text: Apply extensionality of cochain maps in every degree, and mapped-coproduct extensionality through fixed inverse image followed by scalar realization. It suffices to test every total-degree injection indexed by a+b=n.

Apply the proved commutativity of the native summand diagram. Its total edges are precisely the degree components of the chain diagram edges. Thus its fully proved pasting calculation gives the required injection equality.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorNativeChain_commutes
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) :
    let G := finiteScalarTensorNativeChainDiagram R p P Q
    G.l1 ≫ G.l2 ≫ G.l3 = G.right
